Comparison

Midjourney vs Adobe Firefly

A side-by-side look at Midjourney and Adobe Firefly, using the details in each tool profile.

Quick take

Choose Midjourney when your priority is: artistic, stylised imagery where aesthetic quality matters more than precise control. Choose Adobe Firefly when your priority is: commercially safe generation inside an existing Adobe design workflow.

Midjourney vs Adobe Firefly at a glance

CriteriaMidjourneyAdobe Firefly
CategoryAI Image GeneratorsAI Image Generators
Best forArtistic, stylised imagery where aesthetic quality matters more than precise control.Commercially safe generation inside an existing Adobe design workflow.
Pricing modelSubscriptionUsage-based
Free planNoYes
Free trialNoYes
API availableNoYes
Platforms
  • Web app (midjourney.com), Discord bot
  • Web, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, InDesign, Express, Lightroom
  • iOS and Android
Key features
  • Text-to-image with distinctive aesthetic quality
  • image-to-image and style references (--sref)
  • character references (--cref)
  • Vary, Zoom, Pan and inpainting editors
  • personalisation trained on your own ratings
  • Moodboards
  • Text-to-image, Generative Fill and Generative Expand in Photoshop
  • Text to Vector in Illustrator
  • Generative Remove and Extend in Premiere Pro
  • Text to Video and Text to Sound Effects
  • Firefly Boards for moodboarding
  • custom models trained on your brand assets (enterprise)
Advantages
  • Consistently the best aesthetic output of any image generator - this is not a close contest for stylised and artistic work
  • style and character reference systems give strong series consistency
  • unlimited Relax generation on Standard and above makes high-volume exploration cheap
  • commercial rights included on all plans.
  • The only major generator offering genuine enterprise IP indemnification, which is decisive for regulated brands
  • training data provenance is defensible
  • Generative Fill in Photoshop is the single most-used generative feature in professional design work
  • Content Credentials support real provenance disclosure.
Limitations
  • No free tier at all, so evaluation costs money
  • no official API, which blocks programmatic integration
  • text rendering inside images remains weak compared with Ideogram
  • precise compositional control is harder than with tools offering layers or masks
  • Raw image quality trails Midjourney noticeably for artistic work
  • credit system is confusing and allowances have been reduced over time to community frustration
  • locked into Adobe's subscription economics including annual-plan cancellation fees
  • prompt adherence is weaker than newer competitors

Pricing notes

Midjourney

Basic $10/mo or $96/yr ($8/mo) - 3.3 Fast GPU hours (200 minutes), no Relax mode, SD video only, 3 concurrent Fast jobs. Standard $30/mo or $288/yr ($24/mo) - 15 Fast GPU hours plus unlimited Relax mode images. Pro $60/mo or $576/yr ($48/mo) - 30 Fast hours, unlimited Relax images and SD video, Stealth Mode, 12 concurrent Fast jobs. Mega $120/mo or $1,152/yr ($96/mo) - 60 Fast hours, same unlimited Relax, Stealth Mode. Additional Fast GPU time $4/hour on all plans. Annual billing saves 20%.

Adobe Firefly

Free plan with a small monthly generative credit allowance (historically 25 credits). Firefly Standard around $9.99/mo (about 2,000 credits). Firefly Pro around $29.99/mo (about 7,000 credits). Firefly Premium around $199.99/mo for very high volume. Creative Cloud subscriptions include generative credits by plan tier. Enterprise custom with custom models and full indemnification. Verify - Adobe has revised credit allowances repeatedly.

Prices change often. Confirm on the official pricing pages: Midjourney ↗ · Adobe Firefly ↗

Frequently asked questions

What is the main difference between Midjourney and Adobe Firefly?

Midjourney: Subscription image generation service widely regarded as producing the most artistically striking output. Adobe Firefly: Adobe's generative AI family, trained on Adobe Stock and public-domain content and marketed as commercially safe with IP indemnification.

When should I choose Midjourney over Adobe Firefly?

Midjourney is listed as best for: artistic, stylised imagery where aesthetic quality matters more than precise control. Adobe Firefly is listed as best for: commercially safe generation inside an existing Adobe design workflow.

Do Midjourney and Adobe Firefly have a free plan?

Midjourney: No. Adobe Firefly: Yes. Check each official pricing page, as plans change.
